svg.title: From decision 612's feature values to its three values
svg.desc: Decision 612, the Comintern's network after one network update, width 64; each vector shown by its first 4 of 64 numbers. Left, every zone, Shensi shown, all 37 the same way: Shensi's feature vector, 9 non-zero feature values of 35,342, goes through the embedding layer, gets its identity embedding and static features added and is layer-normalized into Shensi's zone vector, −0.294, 1.957, −1.422, −0.203, …. Right, the state as a whole: the global feature vector, 131 non-zero feature values of 2,779, goes through the embedding layer and layer normalization into the global vector, −1.063, −1.073, −1.086, 0.935, …. Two message-passing layers follow: each adds to Shensi's vector what its 4 neighbours send and the global vector, and to the global vector the average of the 37 zone vectors. After them Shensi's vector is 0.027, 1.158, −0.829, 1.170, …, and the global vector −1.064, −0.207, −2.095, −0.117, …. For each of the 64 numbers, the average of the 37 zone vectors, 0.159, −1.371, 0.093, 0.126, …, and their largest value, 1.995, 1.158, 2.248, 3.327, …, are joined with the global vector into 3 × 64 = 192 numbers, which a linear layer, GELU and layer normalization turn into the summary vector of the state, −0.597, 3.316, 1.445, −0.710, …. The value head's first linear layer and GELU turn it into 64 numbers, −0.154, −0.154, −0.155, 0.395, …; its second linear layer, with no activation function, into 3 numbers: Axis 0.251, Allies −0.424, Comintern -1.024. Times 100, from hundreds of points to points, these are the values: Axis +25.1, Allies −42.4, Comintern −102.4. The values read the board only through the summary vector, and never read the legal actions; training moves them toward the final scores.
